title: Pan-Seared Tofu Bowls with Chili Oil
description: Crisp-seared tofu over brown rice with edamame and broccoli, finished with a spoonful of chili oil.
ingredients: 350 g extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
steps: Sear the pressed tofu in a hot pan until golden on most sides.
Build bowls with rice, broccoli, edamame and tofu, then finish with chili oil.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste pan-seared tofu bowls

notes: Pressing the tofu for at least 15 minutes is the difference between a crisp sear and a soggy one.
